crossRefs.note: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets…

translations.web: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
translations.bsb: So there are to be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
translations.kjv: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
translations.asv: And there shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
